narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -1.01 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.03867-0.03875 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.03917; the first objective pays 0.99R at 0.03844.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.03917 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: 3-TF alignment incomplete AND no absorption/CVD-divergence at the zone (3-TF: H4 13×89 trend · H1 structure against · m15 bar lost EMA89)
